related_declarations_reviewed.name: jordan_comm
related_declarations_reviewed.mathematical_basis: The half-sum J_T(X,Y) is symmetric by additive commutativity of the two actual ordered products. The simplifier instantiates its rule against the parameter-bearing goal.

related_declarations_reviewed.name: bracket_skew
related_declarations_reviewed.mathematical_basis: Exchanging the inputs negates their normalized half-difference. smul_sub and module normalize the actual ordered products in the goal.

related_declarations_reviewed.name: bracket_self
related_declarations_reviewed.mathematical_basis: Alternation K_T(X,X)=0 follows from subtracting the same ordered product from itself. This is a structural bracket law, without an assumed conclusion or proof hole.

related_declarations_reviewed.name: jordan_self
related_declarations_reviewed.mathematical_basis: The rational half combines two copies of X*T*X into one copy, proving J_T(X,X)=X*T*X on the actual ring carrier.

observed_case.classification_reason: T, X and Y are universally quantified algebra elements, not proposition hypotheses carrying the result. Goal-directed simplification and module normalization use these elements without requiring their names to occur in the tactic text. The regex captures the whole binder string including whitespace and does not inspect proof-term dependence.

reviewed_declarations.name: counts_upper_bound
reviewed_declarations.mathematical_basis: From M_n+S_n=4^n and S_n>=0, the proof derives M_n<=4^n. It explicitly supplies n to counts_sum and counts_nonneg_ordered.

reviewed_declarations.name: spectral_power_bound
reviewed_declarations.mathematical_basis: From M_n+S_n=4^n, M_n-S_n=2^n and S_n>=0, the proof derives 2^n<=4^n. It explicitly supplies n to all prerequisite theorems.
